item.text: The app is on Next.js 16, and its `after()` API is the right fit. One detail matters here: `after()` alone does not make a statically rendered page log each visit, so I’ll make this route request-rendered and keep the analytics call behind a server-only helper.

item.text:
Added the server-rendered welcome page in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1). It schedules page-view logging with Next.js `after()`, so logging runs after the response. The route is request-rendered so the event is recorded per visit.

Added a server-only logger in [analytics.ts](/workspace/app/analytics.ts:1). It emits a structured `analytics.page_view` event to the server logs for collection by an analytics pipeline. No analytics vendor or endpoint was configured in the project. I did not run tests.
